text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: At last, Grass Wonder is set to make<n>her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to the anxiety I feel, she<n>appears
completely undisturbed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She heads for the track, ready to do<n>business as
usual.
